verdict.rationale: Exa documents outbound webhooks for Websets: real-time HTTP callbacks fire as items are added or enriched [exa-docs-21], and async results can be delivered via webhooks alongside the dashboard and API [exa-docs-53]. This is a registrable programmatic event subscription, but the evidence is two short doc lines and covers only Websets. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration API and event-type catalog, payload/signature verification and retry semantics, webhook coverage beyond Websets (e.g., Agent runs or scheduled searches), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
